author: Nectorist
body:
Hello everyone (the 2 people looking at this)! I am augustboy01, but you can just call me August.

Basics:

I have been active on the server for a while, but I haven't been on a team yet. I have recently gotten Skype, so my interest has re-kindled.

I would prefer a defensive position due to my slower computer, but anything works.

I have Skype (augustboy02)

My Skills:

Bow: 6/10

HtH/PVP: 5/10

Strengths: Pretty good using a bow, efficient when attacking, very good at defending.

Weaknesses: Have a slower computer, which hurts my PVP, but isn't too much of a problem.

Thank you for reviewing my application, have a good day!
